record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: If f is quasi-hyperbolic and dissipative and J is connected, do external rays land at J, and is J a finite quotient of the real solenoid?

evidence.quote: Question 24. — If f is quasi-hyperbolic and dissipative, and if J is connected, do the external rays land at J? Is J a finite quotient of the real solenoid?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2$ be a complex Hénon map, i.e., a composition of finitely many maps of the form $(x,y)\mapsto(p(x)-ay,x)$ with $p$ a monic polynomial of degree at least $2$ and $a\in\mathbb{C}^*$. The Jacobian of $f$ is a constant $\delta\in\mathbb{C}^*$; assume $f$ is dissipative, i.e., $|\delta|<1$. Let $K^+=\{z\in\mathbb{C}^2:\{f^n(z)\}_{n\ge0}\text{ is bounded}\}$, $K^-$ defined analogously for $f^{-1}$, $K=K^+\cap K^-$, $J^\pm=\partial K^\pm$, and $J=J^+\cap J^-$. Call $f$ quasi-hyperbolic if it satisfies the appropriate weakening of uniform hyperbolicity on $J$ (no critical tangencies and a uniform expansion/contraction estimate off a neglectable set, in the standard sense for polynomial automorphisms of $\mathbb{C}^2$).

The escaping set $U^+=\mathbb{C}^2\setminus K^+$ admits a Böttcher coordinate $\varphi^+$ semiconjugating $f$ on $U^+$ to $z\mapsto z^d$ on $\{|z|>1\}$, but only up to a covering, so that external rays for $f$ are parameterized by points of the real (dyadic) solenoid $\mathcal{S}=\varprojlim(S^1\xrightarrow{\times d}S^1)$ rather than by $S^1$.

Assume $J$ is connected. Question: Do all external rays land at $J$ (i.e., for every $s\in\mathcal{S}$ the corresponding external ray has a well-defined limit point in $J$), and is $J$ homeomorphic to a finite quotient of the real solenoid $\mathcal{S}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem about quasi-hyperbolic dissipative Hénon maps. The corresponding statements are known in the uniformly hyperbolic connected case (Bedford–Smillie and follow-ups), but for the quasi-hyperbolic case the landing of external rays and identification of the Julia set with a finite quotient of the real solenoid remain unresolved according to recent surveys and related work on quasi-solenoids.

status_evidence.title: Hénon Maps: A List of Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists this as an open question; in the uniformly hyperbolic connected case both properties are known, but the quasi-hyperbolic case is open.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open question in a recent compilation of Hénon-map problems.

status_evidence.title: The solenoid and holomorphic motions for Henon maps
status_evidence.snippet: Treats the solenoidal structure and external rays for hyperbolic Hénon maps with connected Julia set.
status_evidence.claim: Solenoidal description and ray landing are established in the uniformly hyperbolic connected setting, motivating the quasi-hyperbolic version.

status_evidence.title: Julia sets of complex Hénon maps
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of structure of Julia sets, including quasi-solenoids in dissipative settings.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial results exist but the precise question for quasi-hyperbolic dissipative Hénon maps with connected J is not resolved.
